info.title: MSBuild Structured Log Exporter for OpenTelemetry
info.description: Translates MSBuild structured log files to OpenTelemetry spans

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Translates MSBuild structured log files to OpenTelemetry spans.

options.name: --serviceName
options.description: The OpenTelemetry service name to use for the spans. [default: msbuild]

options.name: --console
options.description: Log the emitted spans to the console

options.name: --oltp-endpoint
options.description: The OpenTelemetry endpoint to use for the spans.

options.name: --oltp-header
options.description: Allows for adding arbitrary headers in a key=value format. Use this option multiple times for multiple header values.

arguments.name: LOGFILE
arguments.description: The MSBuild structured log file to parse
